question: Which current CALABARZON waterbody leads have source-reported locality text precise enough to attach a working PSA PSGC city or municipality code without inferring a route or boundary?
method: Reviewed source locality wording and existing source crosswalks, then matched only explicitly named city/municipality labels to their enumerated PSA 10-digit PSGC codes. This is a source-locality metadata pass; name matching did not create geometry or infer a whole channel.

assignments.sourceLocality: Sitio Pag Asa and Sitio Kabisig; Barangay San Jose, Antipolo City; Barangay May-iba, Teresa, Rizal.
assignments.limit: The source describes an adopted monitoring segment; it does not establish the full creek route or geometry.

assignments.sourceLocality: Naic, Cavite; one surveyed lower segment in the BCIB study area.
assignments.limit: The lower study segment is source-located; the full channel extent remains unresolved.

assignments.sourceLocality: The visually reviewed Atlas row lists Tagaytay City in Cavite and separately lists Calamba City and Cabuyao in Laguna.
assignments.limit: The code applies to the source-named locality association only; no route or full channel boundary is inferred.

assignments.sourceLocality: The visually reviewed Atlas row spans Calamba City in Laguna and Lipa City, Malvar, Santo Tomas, and Tanauan City in Batangas.

codes.name: City of Sto. Tomas
codes.locality: Santo Tomas (PSGC crosswalk name: City of Sto. Tomas)

assignments.limit: The source supplies localities, not the precise reach in each locality or full channel geometry.

assignments.sourceLocality: The city profile describes the Bacoor segment through named Bacoor barangays and its drainage to Bacoor Bay.
assignments.limit: Narrative city and barangay context is not a surveyed river line.

assignments.sourceLocality: Bacoor City; the profile describes the river draining the eastern part of the southern watershed and meeting Molino River at Molino Dam.
assignments.limit: No surveyed route or station coordinates are supplied.

assignments.sourceLocality: Bacoor City and Dasmariñas City; the source describes the river meeting Don Cella River at Molino Dam and spilling into Zapote River.
assignments.limit: The source crosswalk is narrative and describes an upper course toward Molino Dam; full channel extent remains unresolved.

notAssignedThisBatch.reason: The 2014 Cavite profile locates named portions within a protected landscape that spans Ternate and Maragondon, Cavite and part of Nasugbu, Batangas, but does not assign the individual river portions to a municipality or define routes.
DPWH Annex D-2 identifies Region IV-A basin rows but does not provide province or municipality allocation; separate Quezon name variants do not prove identity with the principal basins.
The Ternate Adopt-a-Waterbody signatories do not define the adopted one-kilometer segment locality sufficiently to code the full river lead.

The Atlas prints City of Biñan; Carmona; and Carmonan; GMA; Silang across a visually continued row. Whether Carmonan is a typo for Carmona is unresolved, so no municipality code was added from that ambiguous label.

nonClaims: City or municipality codes record source-described locality mentions only; they are not river routes, watershed boundaries, polygons, coordinates, fishing grounds, or evidence of legal access.
The seven updated leads remain research leads. No fish occurrence, catchability, diet, safety, or fishing-rule conclusion was created.
The 158-lead CALABARZON waterbody inventory remains incomplete and scopeFrozen remains false.
No raw source table, map, or coordinates were copied into the public app projection.
nextAction: Continue source-backed locality review across the 144 province-only leads while separately reconciling the four leads without any locality code, source-derived missing waterbodies, shared-water relationships, and reusable geometry. Add codes only where reviewed source text identifies a locality; keep scope unfrozen.
